summary: No installer-harm indicators observed in svelte-streaks@1.0.0
details: Analysis of svelte-streaks@1.0.0 surfaced no a static rule matches and no traced behaviors indicative of credential theft, install-time code execution, silent relay, backdoor, or self-propagation. The package's shipped contents show no lifecycle scripts, no outbound network calls to attacker-controlled destinations, no reads of installer-secret paths, and no obfuscated or fetch-and-execute patterns.
